/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import html, json, os, re, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

tabs = json.load(open('/tmp/chrome_tabs.json'))
outdir = Path('/home/user/Documents/Blog')
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
blogs = []
for t in tabs:
    if t.get('type') "'!= '"'page':
        continue
    url = t.get('url','')
    title = html.unescape(t.get('title','')).strip()
    if 'lilianweng.github.io/posts/' in url:
        blogs.append((title, url))

def safe_name(title):
    s = re.sub(r'[\\x00-\\x1f<>:\"/\\\\|?*]+', ' ', title)
    s = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s).strip().rstrip('.')
    return (s[:180] or 'article') + '.pdf'

for title, url in blogs:
    path = outdir / safe_name(title)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='chrome-pdf-') as profile:
        cmd = [
            'google-chrome', '--headless=new', '--disable-gpu', '--no-sandbox',
            '--disable-dev-shm-usage', f'--user-data-dir={profile}',
            '--run-all-compositor-stages-before-draw', '--virtual-time-budget=10000',
            f'--print-to-pdf={path}', url,
        ]
        print(f'Printing: {title}\\n  {url}\\n  -> {path}')
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=120)
        print(res.stdout.strip())
        if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise SystemExit(f'Failed to create {path}')
print('\\nCreated PDFs:')
for p in sorted(outdir.glob('*.pdf')):
    print(f'{p.name}\\t{p.stat().st_size} bytes')
PY"
